name: Prism Lighthouse
description: A tall lighthouse whose beacon is a massive rotating prism that casts spectacular rainbows across the dark ocean, creating a mesmerizing light show.
prompt: A towering lighthouse on a rocky coastal cliff, its beacon not a simple light but a massive rotating crystalline prism at the top. As it spins, it projects spectacular rainbows across the dark ocean and sky. Waves crash against rocks below. Night setting with dramatic lighting, the rainbow beams cutting through the darkness. Ultra-detailed, cinematic, 8k
caption: This lighthouse doesn't just warn ships—it paints the night with pure magic! 🌈🗼 Every rotation of its prismatic heart sends ribbons of color dancing across the waves. If you followed a rainbow trail, where do you think it would lead? The end might be closer than you think...
